title: Open Montage launches free AI-powered full #openmontage #aivideoproduction #aistudio
description: Open Montage launched the first agentic video production system that transforms Claude Code into a full production studio with zero cost. It generates videos from simple English prompts using AI agents that handle research, scripting, voiceover, visuals, and editing. Equipped with 11 production pipelines and over 400 agent skills, it supports creating animated explainers, cinematic trailers, product ads, talking head videos, podcast clips, and more. Its live web search integration ensures video content is based on up-to-date information from YouTube, Reddit, and news sites. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot, Open Montage requires no API key as it operates locally using free tools. This innovation significantly lowers the cost and complexity of professional video production, making it accessible for creators, marketers, and businesses. #OpenMontage #ClaudeCode #AIVideoProduction #AgenticAI #VideoEditingAI #ContentCreation #AIAgents #CinematicTrailers #ProductAds #ExplainerVideos #AIResearch #CursorAI #CopilotAI #FreeVideoTools #AIProductionStudio
